sn55.9:1.1: nisinno kho āyasmā Ānando Bhagavantam etad avoca ||
sn55.9:1.4: Asokā nāma bhante bhikkhunī kālakatā || la ||
sn55.9:1.5: Asoko nāma bhante upāsako kālakato || la ||
sn55.9:1.7: tassā kā gati ko abhisamparāyo ti || || 3--6.
sn55.9:2.1: Asoko Ānanda bhikkhu kālakato āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttim paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayam abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsi || ||
sn55.9:3.1: Ayaṃ kho so Ānanda dhammādāso dhammapariyāyo
sn55.9:3.2: yena samannāgato ariyasāvako ākaṅkamāno attanā va attānam vyākareyya
sn55.9:3.3: Khīṇanirayomhi || khīṇatiracchāyoniko khīṇapettivisayo khīṇāpāyaduggativinipāto || sotāpanno ham asmi avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyano ti || || 2.
